title: Risk — An Unrecognized Answer Is Never Evidence of Safety
note: This family is OPEN to overlays, and that creates a hole a ladder alone cannot close: an overlay may ADD a label, an added label has no rung, and a rule stated only over the enumerated set is uncomputable for it — so the permissive reading wins by default and an unrecognized answer reads as 'not irreversible, proceed'. The residual rule inverts that: any label not named in the ladder ranks at the MOST-RESTRICTIVE position, and a consumer receiving a label it does not recognize MUST treat the act as irreversible. Note the ceiling rung — an act can be irreversible AND already observed by third parties, and deleting the artifact afterwards does not move it back down the ladder.
